“Talent is insignificant., I know a lot of talented ruins. Beyond talent lie all the usual words: Discipline, Love, Luck, but most of all, Endurance.” - James Baldwin

This President is a disaster for everyone, except for his own bank account.

Video

This is awesome.

Video

Trading stocks should be illegal for all elected politicians, especially the president.

This is yet another clear example of Trump’s blatant corruption.

Donald Trump is committing one of the most brazen and corrupt acts in modern presidential history. He and his inner circle are shamelessly enriching themselves with taxpayer dollars, while working families are being crushed by skyrocketing prices.

We must call out not only this corruption, but the enablers and the silent Members of Congress who are complicit in this theft from the American people. We will not be silent.

Video

Working families are already paying the price for Trump’s chaos and corruption, but now he is taking it even further. The $1.8 billion Trump slush fund–with no congressional oversight or accountability, entirely from taxpayer dollars–is a ripe opportunity for corruption.

We must demand answers on this obvious and unprecedented grift.

There is a quiet emergency in America making us sicker and poorer.

Sicker because the food we are feeding our families is driving a chronic disease epidemic.

Poorer because a handful of mega-corporations are driving up the costs of groceries, insurance, and prescription drugs for diseases they shouldn’t have gotten in the first place.

We must not stand for it. We must rise with a chorus of conviction and demand a government that truly represents every single one of us.

Now, thanks to his chaos and corruption, Americans are being crushed by high prices at the pump and slammed with rising energy bills. 

We need to act now to ease the pain on working families.

Over 100 years ago today, the Supreme Court struck a blow against Black Americans in Plessy v. Ferguson. Just days ago, the court struck another blow against us.

It took a movement moment to end “separate but equal” with Brown v. Board. We must meet this moment with a movement of our own — one that mobilizes, organizes, and fights relentlessly for what is right.

It is an unassailable fact that Trump is selling out America for his own personal profit. This stock trading, which should be illegal for all presidents and politicians, is gross corruption and should be offensive to every American.
